'''Cryodex''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] encryption device. Very few Cryodexes were off-planet when [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was destroyed by the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] Cartel used a stolen Cryodex for encrypting their blackmail sources.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
